request.prompt: A restrained low cello sings a quiet slow lament above only a few muted piano notes. Narrow sorrowful melodic movement and soft sustained bowing, a small chamber duet, little vibrato, no soloist display, no orchestral bloom or emotional climax. Two alternative scenes share this cue: discovering a companion dead inside a wooden inn, and cradling another companion who has died after a forest battle. Intimate musical scale for reading dialogue. A small memorable minor-key phrase, slow falling gestures, gentle unresolved suspensions, long natural note tails with breathing room, restrained dynamics and very soft attacks. Continuous low-key musical presence for the full 25 seconds; no abrupt note cutoff or early ending. Keep the grief deeply sad and calm. No hopeful major-key lift, sweet romantic mood, cheerful pentatonic tune, playful rhythm, heroic sacrifice fanfare, victorious resolution or big dramatic swell. No fast rhythm, marching beat, pounding drums, bright bells, sparkling piano runs or busy arpeggios. No dissonant horror clusters, jump scares or aggressive low impacts; this is loss and mourning. Instrumental only, no voice, choir, speech, rain, wind, insects, crackles, footsteps or environmental sound effects.
